title: An agent for researchers.
lead: Literature review, citation work, the formatting tax. Handed off so you can think.

customSkills.title: Literature search
customSkills.desc: Pulls papers from PubMed, arXiv, Scholar. Clusters by method, ranks by relevance.

customSkills.title: Citation manager
customSkills.desc: Maintains Zotero, dedupes entries, inserts properly-formatted cites into Overleaf.

customSkills.title: Methods comparison
customSkills.desc: Produces a matrix of datasets, sample sizes, and stated limitations across papers.

automations.title: Weekly alert digest
automations.desc: New papers matching saved queries arrive Monday 8am with a two-line 'why this matters'.

automations.title: Manuscript prep
automations.desc: Checks figure resolution, reference completeness, and journal formatting in Overleaf.

automations.title: Co-author sync
automations.desc: Edits in shared Overleaf become a diff summary, reviewer responses tracked.

footerBlurb: Subject data, unpublished manuscripts, and IRB documents stay inside your institutional storage. HIPAA and FERPA aware where applicable.
